responseText:
That's a job for our runescribes, but if you're keen to help, here's what I'd do:

Clear a path through as many as you can. That'll make it easier to information from Hammer Rest going foward. Some of the clay ones have strange runes on gold plates bolted to their frames, too. If you find one, bring it to Runescribe Flinthelm in Hammer Rest.

Perhaps, with your help, we can learn a bit about this foe.
